retired_screen_model.message: ADR-066 retires ScreenModel from frontends and bindings; consume generic Command values.

retired_workflow_engine.message: ADR-066 retires WorkflowEngine from frontends and bindings; Core owns workflows.

retired_user_action.message: ADR-066 retires UserAction from frontends and bindings; emit opaque Event values.

retired_action_result.message: ADR-066 retires ActionResult from frontends and bindings; consume generic Command values.

retired_domain_components.message: ADR-066 forbids domain-bearing component and visibility types in shells.

retired_visibility_labels.message: ADR-066 forbids domain-bearing visibility labels in shells.

split_dispatch_api.message: ADR-066 requires one Event input and Command[] output; retire action/result/screen dispatch APIs.

frontend_image_encoding.message: ADR-042: a shell passes raw image bytes and Core converts avatars to WebP <= 32 KB; do not encode or resize an image before handing it on.

error_substring_classification.message: Core must return typed error codes; frontend must not classify errors by substring.

notification_category_mapping.message: NotificationCategory mapping to OS presentation belongs in core.

retired_onboarding_preferences.message: Core owns onboarding and demo state; do not restore retired shell preferences (#762).
